text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Japanese Derby. 
Sakura Chiyono O, having fought a fierce 
battle, continued her diligent efforts 
without losing any of her passion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Like an onion, there's always another 
layer underneath!" I still have so much 
left to do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep working tirelessly and 
diligently, so that someday, even 
Maruzen-san will—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On another day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-Trainer...! Um, um um um...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san invited me to run a mock race 
with her...!
choice_data_list: I see! When do you think it'll be ready?
Oh, really! When will it be?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? It's this weekend! Wait, Trainer, 
you seem really into this!?
choice_data_list: Because that was your goal, wasn't it?
That was your goal, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So, when that happens...! Would you... 
run with the stronger me again...?!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Always.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"She is my goal, my inspiration, and the 
rival I wish to stand beside."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, from that day on, I began studying 
Maruzensky so as not to lose to her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Maruzen-san's races, the 
footage of the 'Asahi Hai FS' is 
absolutely essential, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming front-running lead and 
superb racing sense. And above all else, 
that joyful smile...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (...Somehow, Maruzen-san's running style—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the center of the commotion were Sweep 
Tosho, who dreams of becoming a witch like 
her grandmother, and Triple Crown 
Umamusume Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I told you, no such medicine exists! 
Grandma told me so!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then let me talk directly with that 
Grandma of yours. I know for a fact her 
abilities are certified top-notch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Bleh, so there! My grandma is my grandma, 
no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like I got turned down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Umm... C.B.-san?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"No need to warn them anymore. They've run 
out of loud things to talk about... hm?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O...? If I recall, you're 
racing with Maruzen this weekend, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Does it really have to be right now? 
Like, couldn't it wait until later or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just can't bring myself to accept it 
after all. I've always wanted to see the 
moment the gears of that supercar of the 
century shift into drive.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Chiyono O. I'm sure your wish 
won't come true either."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, are you saying that 
I... cannot beat Maruzen-san?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...No. More importantly, it's what matters 
most to you and Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Say, Chiyonoo. I hear you want to become 
like Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you want to replace 
"Maruzensky"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, that's not it! Maruzen-san is 
Maruzen-san, and that's why she's 
Maruzen-san!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's why if you run like this, 
the one who will regret it is definitely 
going to be you, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That person surely won't become your 
rival. She will just leave you behind all 
on your own.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Leave all your baggage there. ...Are you 
sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...? I-I'm sorry...! I still don't quite 
understand what you mean...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, deep down, I understand. I mean, even 
you must have noticed it by now, right? 
The loneliness that "monster" carries.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Mr. Trainer. This is a 
sensation only those who run can 
understand. Just like how only support 
staff truly know what it takes to support.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Ms. Trainer. This is a 
sensation only those who run can 
understand. Just like how only support 
staff truly know what it takes to support.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And an answer isn't something you ask for. 
If she doesn't have the answer inside her 
right now, she won't find it for the rest 
of her life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, the day of my promise with 
Maruzensky arrived.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo-chan, great job in the Derby! You've 
truly grown into a wonderful horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, shall we race? This time, it's 
a Derby just for the two of us♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(And thus, the mock race with just the two 
of us, me and Maruzen-san, began.)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna fly like the wind~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Ripping through the air right before my 
eyes, the 'Supercar' unleashes her 
sensational speed.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...So fast. But today, I'm the one who'll—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Remember how it felt in the Derby. That 
day when you competed against your rivals 
and brought out your absolute full 
potential!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Feeling their strength, their feelings, 
with my very skin—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. That's fine.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just pass right by me like that. ...If you 
reach me, I'll give you your final 
present.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So go on ahead of me—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I felt like I finally understood what 
C.B.-san meant.)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo-chan!? What's wrong, do your legs 
hurt!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...That's not it, Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What a relief. You didn't get hurt 
after all. Jeez, stopping in the middle of 
a race like that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Where is Maruzen-san...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, you aren't really worried 
about losing to me, are you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I watched all of your past races. For the 
sake of this race. I went back and 
rewatched every single one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That was when the thought hit me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe Maruzen-san has never once felt 
desperately that she 'didn't want to 
lose'.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san. Having a rival is amazing. It 
lets you put in more effort and run faster 
than you ever could before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That is why I was able to become this 
strong. Why I learned to give every race 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san. What am I to you, 
Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, that's... Chiyo-chan is a 
precious junior to me. She looks up to me 
so much...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I always wanted to be you. But I 
didn't want to just be you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to gain strength like yours, and 
become a special Umamusume like you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be your rival...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...! Chiyo-chan...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“There's no fire burning in your heart, 
though. It feels more like you've given 
up... accepting things as they are.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...But that's—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, Maruzen-san. In that case, I 
will simply work harder until I become 
someone worthy of you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I can truly become your 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I still can't ignite that 'desire to 
win' inside you, then I'll just have to 
work even harder."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To force all your strength out into the 
open. I shall ignite an engine within you 
that you have never used before.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even if you put it that way, I'm 
already just...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please don't let it end like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I want you to run with all your 
heart. Because I've come to realize just 
how wonderful that truly is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me, Maruzen-san. Not my 
growth, but my running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely become a true rival to 
Maruzensky, as Sakura Chiyono O."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …………Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have a request. It's about our 
next goal.
choice_data_list: ...What do you want to do after this?
...What do you want to do next?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to head for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), where not just Classic Class 
Umamusume, but Senior Class Umamusume as 
well, compete for top speed."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—I will undoubtedly ignite a fire in 
Maruzen-san's heart there.
